mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO wecom_school_department(id, parent_id, name, name_en, order_num, department_leader, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{item.id}, #{item.parentId}, #{item.name}, #{item.nameEn}, #{item.orderNum}, #{item.departmentLeader}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateTime})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE parent_id = VALUES(parent_id), name = VALUES(name), name_en = VALUES(name_en), order_num = VALUES(order_num), department_leader = VALUES(department_leader), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
